issue.title: preview_aggregate builds the artifact-link event snapshot twice, reading the outbox and durable roots twice per reconcile

task_type_fields.impact: sase's hourly `artifact_link_backfill` reconcile/repair (37-59 s) is the chop's longest uninterruptible step once the outbox drain is fast. The chop now refuses to start reconcile without headroom, so a slow preview means sase's reconcile gets deferred more often. Interactive `sase artifact doctor --fix` and any other `preview_aggregate` / `rebuild_aggregate` caller pay the duplicate cost too.
task_type_fields.repro:
`ArtifactLinkStore.preview_aggregate()` (`src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_store_aggregate.py:69`) builds `self.artifact_link_event_snapshot(include_pending=True, strict=True, exclude_pending_event_ids=...)`, then immediately calls `self._load_store_truth_rows(include_pending=True, exclude_pending_event_ids=...)`, which builds a second, identical snapshot (`src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_store_rows.py:247`). Every reconcile preview therefore scans every durable link-event root twice and parses the whole pending outbox twice.

Measured on athena while planning `plan:202611/artifact_link_backfill_timeouts.md` (sase, ~12.9k queued outbox rows): `store.preview_aggregate()` took 59 s and read the outbox 4 times. That plan's single-read pending snapshot (`pending_artifact_link_outbox_snapshot`) halves this to 2 outbox reads, but the duplicated snapshot build remains. One full outbox parse costs ~3.7-4.7 s for sase, and the durable-root scan is paid twice as well.

Suggested fix: let `_load_store_truth_rows` accept a prebuilt `event_snapshot` (or have `preview_aggregate` derive store-truth rows from the snapshot it already built). Then make sure `_authoritative_source_was_consulted_for_pass` and the strict/non-strict difference still see the same snapshot. Verify with a counting test on `_read_outbox_records_unlocked` (expect one read per preview) and re-time `preview_aggregate()` on the real sase store.

issue.creation_reason: Out-of-scope follow-up named by the approved artifact_link_backfill_timeouts plan: after its single-read pending fix, reconcile previews still duplicate the whole event snapshot.
